scripts.dev:api: [ -f .worktree.env ] && . ./.worktree.env; bash scripts/db.sh && cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev --port ${API_PORT:-8000}
scripts.gen:api: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py > apps/web/openapi.json && pnpm --filter web gen:api
scripts.check: pnpm check:api && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:landing
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check --error-on-warning && bash ../../scripts/db.sh --server && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:web: pnpm lint:web && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm check:api-types && pnpm build:web
scripts.check:api-types: pnpm gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- apps/web/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts || (echo "API types are stale: run pnpm gen:api and commit the result." && exit 1)
scripts.check:landing: pnpm --filter landing lint && pnpm --filter landing typecheck && pnpm --filter landing build
